## ACCEPT — the card's measurements all hold; its **title claim** does not

By the dispatching seat (`session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`, `os-justin`), 18:0xZ. Verified against `origin/main` and the diff — ⛔ not against the report's account of itself.

### The distinction this delivery draws is the valuable part

Every objectui-side measurement in the card re-verified **exact**: `tool-display.ts:221` (`resetsTonight?: boolean`), `:373` (`asOptionalFlag(...)`), and `resetsAt` at zero occurrences repo-wide in `plugin-chatbot`. ⇒ The card's *readings* are sound.

What is falsified is its **title**: *"free-plan users now get a reset promise with nothing behind it."* The card itself flagged that it had **not** measured the render path and that the answer would change the priority. It has now been measured, and the answer is **RENDERS NOTHING**, not renders a false promise.

I re-derived the load-bearing half rather than accepting it, **with a control in the other direction**:

- `resetsTonight` occurs in non-test source **exactly twice** — the declaration at `:221` and the parse at `:373`. **Zero readers after the parse.** ✅
- **Control fires**: the same grep for `messageEn` returns consumers in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`. ⇒ The zero is a reading, not a broken query. ✅
- `parseAiQuotaError` / `AiQuotaError` are **absent from the package barrel** — so there is no external consumer either. ✅

⇒ The banner text is exactly *"Upgrade needed"* + the server's own `messageEn` + *"Upgrade plan"*. **The `true` → `false` flip changes not one rendered byte.** Per the dispatch's own terms, the grade should drop.

⭐ Three ablations, each with on-disk proof (marker counts, and a pre-mutation blob hash verified equal to `HEAD`'s) and a restore proof by blob hash and empty `git diff HEAD`. The two copy ablations are complementary — one reddens the invariance pin and leaves the accounting pin green, the other does the reverse — which is what stops a single mutation from being able to explain both.

### ⭐ Two things it added that the card could not have

- ⚠️ **The wire POSITION of `resetsAt` in the 429 body (`error.details` vs top-level) has never been measured** — it is an inference from the cloud seat's prose. ⇒ *"A reader built on a guessed position fails silently."* That is precisely the failure mode this card is *about*, one level up, and it is why the obvious fix cannot responsibly be written from this repo.
- ⚠️ **Wiring a reset sentence would collide with a standing ruling.** objectui#7253 deliberately ruled that *"one 429 can never be described by two different sentences on the same screen."* ⛔ Adding reset copy beside the server's own prose is the thing that ruling forbids.

⇒ Together those close off the "just read `resetsAt`" repair as a seat-level action, on two independent grounds. Correctly not taken.

The cloud-side premise is properly attributed as the `repo:cloud` seat's reading and **not** confirmed — `objectstack-ai/cloud` is outside this session's scope. ⭐ And the report explicitly refuses to offer `AiUsageIndicator`'s `resetsAt` as corroboration, naming it as the card's own §2 trap. That trap was set for exactly this moment and it did not catch anyone.

### PR #8131 — ACCEPT

`packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.quotaResetPromise-7587.test.tsx` (new), `tool-display.test.ts` (+38), `tool-display.ts` (**+18, comment only**), and an **empty-frontmatter changeset** (releases nothing). **+193 / −0.** No governed path. **The production diff is comment-only** — `Clause-②` stays `no`, and the report states plainly that no interface field, symbol or barrel entry was added.

The lint narrowing is a *declared* narrowing with real reasoning, not a silent one: all three changed files live in one package, the diff changes no eslint config so no untouched file's verdict can move, and `object-ui/no-unused-imports` — the error-severity rule that cost a sibling card a round — reported **0 errors**. Accepted.

### ⭐ The out-of-scope find is the sharpest thing in this round

**#8130** — there are **two files named `tool-display.test.ts`** in `packages/plugin-chatbot`: one at `src/tool-display.test.ts` (the 460-line quota-pin file) and one at `src/__tests__/tool-display.test.ts` (a 91-line helper). I confirmed both exist on `main`.

⇒ A path-filtered run of the `__tests__` spelling **exits 0 having run none of the quota pins**, and objectui#3240's zero-match protection **cannot fire, because both spellings match a real file**. That is a green result that proves nothing, produced by a guard that is working as designed. Exactly the class of defect this lane keeps paying for.

## ⛔ `pm:retriage` — the grade should drop, and that is not mine to set

`priority:p2` was awarded on the reading that a user-visible string is wrong. Measured, no user-visible string in this repo derives from the flag. ⛔ `priority:*` is the triage seat's sole production, so I am not touching it — requesting the re-grade instead.

⚠️ Also for triage: **this card still has no audit comment from the grading seat** (verified at claim time by an explicit `get_comments` call), so the original p2 rationale is not recorded anywhere on it.

The open question that remains — wire `resetsAt`, or retire `resetsTonight` as declared-but-unenforced — is a real one, but ⛔ its blocking input is a **producer fact from `cloud`**, so an objectui card for it would sit unactionable. The dev's recommendation, which I endorse: **A now** (parsed, unread, both the inertness and the parse's silence pinned, reasoning recorded at the field), and raise the wire-position question as a **cloud-side measurement request** rather than an objectui card. ⛔ Not C while that is open — retiring the flag and then wanting reset copy would mean deriving the same envelope twice.
